title: The first self-driving vehicle on Mars has proven to be a smashing success
summary: Sometime next week, NASA’s newest rover on Mars, Perseverance, will set a record for the most distance driven by any vehicle on another world. After a few years on Mars, Curiosity operators noted significant wear and tear on the vehicle’s wheels.
